description: Single-Spark Hunyuan3D 2.1 job: one object image in, one PBR textured mesh out, the creator's demo.py path. The shape stage is the creator's flow-matching pipeline with its defaults (50 steps, guidance 5.0, octree resolution 384), seeded with a CPU generator as the creator's Gradio app does (the Gradio app's steps and octree controls are deliberately not offered; demo.py's defaults run); the paint stage then textures the mesh from the same image. The image is opened as RGBA and nothing removes its background, as in the creator's demo, so give a cutout (its alpha defines the object); an image without alpha is used whole. The GLB is written by this recipe with the creator's material mapping (R = 255, G = roughness, B = metallic), because the creator's exporters need bpy, which has no aarch64 build, or embed JPEG bytes as data: URIs under a PNG media type, which the GLB validation refuses. There is no normal map. The creator's paint step fixes its own settings and this recipe leaves them alone: it remeshes to at most 40,000 faces, unwraps UVs with xatlas, paints six 512 px views in 15 UniPC steps with guidance 3.0 and seed 0, upscales each view with Real-ESRGAN x4, and bakes a 2048 px texture. The Hunyuan3D 2.1 Community License does not apply in the European Union, United Kingdom or South Korea, needs a separate licence above one million monthly active users, and its source headers say non-commercial. Recorded for information, never gated.

seed.description: Seed of the shape stage; the creator's Gradio default is 1234 and its maximum 10,000,000. The paint stage is fixed to seed 0 by the creator.
